goal: Prevent network observers from correlating I2P session creation with outbound connection timing
Improves privacy for users connecting to I2P peers without listening mode
reviewability: Needs rebase and author confirmation to proceed after six months of silence
agreement: Concept approval for decoupling session creation to improve anonymity (zzzi2p)
Resource waste concerns resolved by reducing idle sessions from 10 to 1 (zzzi2p, eyedeekay, mzumsande)
Startup rate-limit concern answered by clarifying sessions are not made in a tight loop (zzzi2p)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because mitigating timing correlation on outbound I2P connections offers modest privacy gains
Transient outbound connection privacy is deferrable relative to broader peer-to-peer relay needs
